question.text: Number of compounds giving (i) red colouration with ceric ammonium nitrate and also (ii) positive iodoform test from the following is _________

solution.text: Red colouration with ceric ammonium nitrate indicates presence of alcholic group, positive iodoform test indicates presence of a secondary alcohol which can oxidise to a methyl ketone. In total 3 compounds from the given will give positive test for both the reactions:
